meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was Owen's grade changed before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
A document drafted somewhere else and pasted in would look exactly like that. I'm writing those times down. You still haven't answered whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero.
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Okay, Hale. Whatever happens next, none of this goes on Owen's record, and it stays quiet. What else do you have?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Give me the page. Students misquote from memory all the time, and a bad quotation isn't a finding.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Fine. I've read the scene, and the line isn't in it. What do you propose to do about the zero?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and a final draft. That's what drafting is.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
That's 4.4. Owen will sit the rewrite to put this behind him. I want it in writing tonight: private, the date before December 1, and nothing on his record.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth works. I'll confirm it with Owen tonight, so put the date and the time in the email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 on Thursday the twelfth after school, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require written confirmation of the date, the time and the privacy of the rewrite, and that nothing goes on his record. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position: she accepted the private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth under procedure 4.4, and she still wants it all in writing tonight with the date and time; that is the fair outcome, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You pointed her to the scene so she could search it herself and find that the quoted line was not there, which gave her something she could check on her own.
What cost ground: Nothing clearly; you owned the early zero in your first sentence and kept every claim tied to a document.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history with its late-night times was the closest you came, and it is where she went shortest and hardest, though it proves nothing about the essay and is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said students change their argument between an outline and an essay, answer that with something she can check, such as another sample of his own writing, before moving to the offer.
